Rashi on Bava Metzia 76a:10:1.hebrew: דעתייהו אעילויא - אע"פ שאמרו לו "הרי אנו נשכרים כדבר בעל הבית", לא לפחות מקצבתו של זה אמרו, אלא להוסיף; וכך אמרו: "מהימנת לן דהכי אמר בעל הבית". וכיון שבעל הבית פוחת, אי אמר להן האי "שכרכם עלי" — יתן משלו, ואי אמר "שכרכם על בעל הבית" — יש להם תרעומת עליו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 76a:10:1.english: Their minds are on an addition - Even though they said to him, "Behold, we are hired according to the employer's words," they did not say [this] to reduce from this [agent's] stipulated rate, but rather to add [to it]. And thus they said: "We trust you that this is what the employer said." And since the employer pays less, if this [agent] said to them, "Your wage is upon me," he must pay from his own [pocket]; and if he said, "Your wage is upon the employer," they have a grievance against him.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 76a:11:1.hebrew: אלא - הא מיבעיא לן: אמר ליה בעל הבית בארבעה, והוא אמר להו תלתא, ואמרו ליה הרי אנו נשכרים כמו שאמר בעל הבית — מאי:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 76a:11:1.english: Rather - This is our question: [If] the employer said to him, "For four [dinars]," and he said to them, "Three," and they said to him, "Behold, we are hired for what the employer said" — what [is the law]?

Rashi on Bava Metzia 76a:11:2.hebrew: אדיבוריה דפועל סמכי - והכי אמרו ליה: מהימנת לן דהכי אמר בעל הבית, ולית להו אלא תלתא, ותרעומת דאל תמנע טוב:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 76a:11:2.english: They rely on the worker's statement - And thus they said to him: "We trust you that the employer said so," and they have [a claim to] only three [dinars], and [grounds for] a grievance of "Do not withhold good."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 76a:11:3.hebrew: או דלמא - לאו לדידיה הימנוהו, אלא הכי אמרו: אחר דברי בעל הבית נלך, ולא סבור וקבול, ושקלי ד':
Rashi on Bava Metzia 76a:11:3.english: Or perhaps - They did not trust him; rather, this is what they said: "We will follow the employer's words," and they did not consent and accept [the three dinars], and [therefore] they take four [dinars].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 76a:12:1.hebrew: ה"ג הבא לי גיטי ואשתך אמרה התקבל לי גיטי - האשה שאמרה לאחד: אם תמצא את בעלי, אמור לו שישלח לי את גיטי בידך, ותיעשה שלוחו של בעלי לגרשני כשמגיע גט לידי. דשליח להולכה על הבעל לעשות, והאשה מתגרשת כשיגיע גט לידה; ושליח לקבלה על האשה לעשות, שיהא הוא שלוחה וכמותה, ותתגרש משיגיע גט ליד שליח:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 76a:12:1.english: This is the reading: "Bring my bill of divorce for me, and your wife said, 'Receive my bill of divorce for me'" - A woman who said to someone: "If you find my husband, tell him to send me my bill of divorce by your hand, and you will become my husband's agent to divorce me when the bill of divorce reaches my hand." For it is up to the husband to appoint an agent for delivery, and the woman is divorced when the bill of divorce reaches her hand; whereas it is up to the woman to appoint an agent for receipt, so that he is her agent and like her [own person], and she is divorced as soon as the bill of divorce reaches the agent's hand.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 76a:13:1.hebrew: אפילו הגיע לידה אינה מגורשת - אלמא אדיבורא דידיה קא סמיך, והכי א"ל: מהימנת לי דכך אמרה, ולא עשאו שליח להולכה. הלכך אין כאן שליחות, ואין עליה לעשות שליח להולכה, והרי "הבא לי" אמרה לו ולא "התקבל", והבעל נתנו — ולא בתורת שליח קבלה — ושליחות זה אינו ביד הבעל לעשות:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 76a:13:1.english: Even [when the bill of divorce] reaches her hand, she is not divorced - Thus [we see that the husband] relies on his [the agent's] word, and this is what he says to him: "You are believed by me that she said so," and he did not make him an agent for delivery. Therefore, there is no agency [for delivery] here. And it is not up to her to appoint an agent for delivery, and behold, she said to him "Bring [it] to me" and not "Receive [it]," and the husband gave it [to him] — yet not in the capacity of an agent for receipt — and this agency [of receipt] is not in the husband's power to effect.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 76a:14:1.hebrew: דאי סלקא דעתך אדיבורא דידה סמיך - ולא לדבריו האמין, אלא "הילך כמה שאמרה היא" קאמר ליה. אם כן, עשאו שליח להולכה, וזו בידו הוא, וכי מטי גיטא לידה מיהא תיגרש:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 76a:14:1.english: For if it enters your mind [that] he relies on her statement - And he did not believe his words, rather he said to him, "Here [it is] for you, as she said." If so, he made him an agent for delivery — and this is within his power [to do] — and when the bill of divorce reaches her hand, at least she should be divorced.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 76a:1:1.hebrew: ואם בעל הבית חוזר בו ידו על התחתונה - יתן להם לפי מה שעשו, ואם הוזלה מלאכת פועלים, על כרחו יתן להם כמה שפסק, חוץ ממה שצריך להוצאות בהשלמתה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 76a:1:1.english: And if the employer retracts, he is at a disadvantage - He must give them according to what they have done; and if [the cost of] workers' labor became cheaper, he must, against his will, give them as much as he stipulated, except for what is needed for expenses in completing it.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 76a:1:2.hebrew: כל המשנה ידו על התחתונה - כגון נתן צמר לצבע לצבעו אדום וצבעו שחור. אם השבח יותר על היציאה, אין נותן לו שכרו משלם אלא דמי יציאת עצים וסממנים, ואם יציאה יתירה על השבח, נותן לו את השבח:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 76a:1:2.english: Whoever changes [the terms] is at a disadvantage - For example, [if one] gave wool to a dyer to dye it red, and he dyed it black. If the appreciation [in value] exceeds the expense, [the owner] does not give him his full wage, [but] rather the cost of the expenditure for wood and dyes, and if the expense exceeds the appreciation, he gives him the appreciation.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 76a:1:3.english: And whoever reneges - In the Gemara it explains what [this] comes to include.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 76a:2:1.hebrew: חזרו בהן לא קתני - דניהוי האי הטעו הם את בעל הבית או בעל הבית אותן, דא"כ הוה ליה למיתני לשון חזרה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 76a:2:1.english: It does not teach: "They reneged" - [meaning] that this [term] "deceived" [would refer to] them [deceiving] the employer, or the employer [deceiving] them; for if so, it should have taught an expression of reneging.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 76a:2:2.english: That the laborers deceived one another - One of the laborers deceived his fellow.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 76a:3:3.english: They understood and accepted - And what is their grievance?

Rashi on Bava Metzia 76a:3:4.hebrew: ואמר להו בארבעה - ולערב לא נתן בעה"ב אלא ג':
Rashi on Bava Metzia 76a:3:4.english: And he told them for four - And in the evening, the employer gave only three.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 76a:6:1.english: What are the circumstances - that they will have a grievance, and nothing more.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 76a:6:2.hebrew: וליחזי פועלים היכי מתגרי - אי מתגרי בארבעה, על כרחיה דבעה"ב ניתיב ארבעה, דהא קתני: נוטל מבעל הבית מה שההנה אותו ואע"פ שלא צוהו, והרי ההנה אותו בכך. ואי מתגרי בשלשה, מאי תרעומת איכא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 76a:6:2.english: And let us see how laborers are hired - If they are hired for four [dinars], the employer must perforce give four, for behold it teaches: "He takes from the employer that which he benefited him, even though he did not instruct him," and behold he benefited him by this [amount]. And if they are hired for three, what grievance is there?

Rashi on Bava Metzia 76a:6:3.english: We would have made an effort - to seek a person who needs laborers, who would hire [us] for four [dinars].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 76a:7:1.hebrew: אי בעית אימא בבעל הבית עסקינן - בפועל שיש לו לעצמו שדות שהן שלו, ואינו נשכר למלאכת אחרים אם לא ביותר על דמי שכירות. והיינו תרעומת, דאי לאו דאמרת לי בד', לא הייתי מזלזל בעצמי:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 76a:7:1.english: If you wish, say we are dealing with a homeowner - With a laborer who has fields of his own that belong to him, and is not hired for the work of others unless for more than [the standard] wage. And this is [their] grievance: "Had you not told me for four [zuz], I would not have demeaned myself."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 76a:8:1.english: Actually, [we are dealing] with laborers - Who are accustomed to the work of others.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 76a:8:2.hebrew: בריפקא - שחפרו חריץ סביבות שדה, ואין מלאכתן ניכרת, כגון דמלו מיא, כדמסיים ואזיל:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 76a:8:2.english: With rifka - [This means] that they dug a trench around a field, and their work is not recognizable, such as when [the trenches] filled with water, as [the Gemara] goes on to conclude.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 76a:9:1.english: Do not withhold good from him to whom it is due - It is a verse in Proverbs.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 76a:10:1.hebrew: דעתייהו אעילויא - באמר להו "שכרכם עלי" איירי, דאי אמר להו "שכרכם על בעל הבית", מאי נפקא מינה אי דעתייהו אעילויא? דבעה"ב לא ישלם להם אלא מה שהתנה. ר"י, וכן רבינו חננאל:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 76a:10:1.english: Their minds are on [any] additional [sum] - [The Gemara] is speaking of [a case where the agent] said to them, "Your wages are upon me"; for if he had said to them, "Your wages are upon the employer," what difference would it make whether their minds are on [any] additional [sum]? For the employer will only pay them what he stipulated. [So explained] Rabbi Yitzchak, and likewise Rabbeinu Chananel.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 76a:14:1.hebrew: דאי ס"ד אדיבורא דידה סמיך, כי מטי גיטא לידה מיהא תתגרש - דאי אמרינן דגבי פועלים דעתיה אעילויא דבעה"ב, ה"נ ה"ל למימר דדעתיה דבעל אעילויא דידה, דאמרה: "הבא לי גיטא". אע"ג דהאי דקאמר שליח: "התקבל לי גיטי", הוי עילויא טפי לבעל שמתגרשת יותר במהרה אם היתה האשה אומרת כן, מכל מקום השתא שאמרה האשה "הבא", הוי טפי זכות הבעל אי סמיך אמאי דקאמר, שתתגרש מיהא כשיגיע גט לידה; וכיון דלא מיגרשא, אלמא לאו דעתיה דבעל אעילויא דידה, ה"נ גבי פועלין לית לן למימר דדעתיה אעילויא דבעה"ב. אבל אין לפרש דעילויא דבעל הוי מה שאינה מתגרשת במהרה — דהא עדיף ליה ממתגרשת לאלתר, כי עכשיו יהיה בידו עדיין אם לקיים אם לגרש — והשתא פשיט ליה בפשיטות; דבסמוך לא יתיישב, דקאמר: "בשלמא אי איתמר איפכא כו' משהגיע גט לידו מגורשת, דאדיבורא דידה קא סמיך", ולפי זה היינו אגריעות' דידה שמתגרשת מהרה, ופשיט דכ"ש דאעילויא דבעה"ב יש לסמוך, וא"כ סותר פשיטות דלעיל, דהוי פשיטא ליה דדעתיה אעילויא דקאמר שליח ולא אגריעותא דבעה"ב, והכא סמיך בעל אגריעותא דידה:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 76a:14:1.english: "As, if it enters your mind that he relies on her statement, when the bill of divorce reaches her hand at least she should be divorced" - For if we say that regarding workers, [the employer's] intention is toward the advantage of the employer, so too here we should say that the husband's intention is toward her advantage, as she said: "Bring my bill of divorce for me." Even though what the agent says, "Receive my bill of divorce for me," would be a greater advantage for the husband—in that she would be divorced more quickly—if the woman had said so, nevertheless, now that the woman said "Bring," it is more of a benefit for the husband if he relies on what she said, so that she is at least divorced when the bill of divorce reaches her hand. And since she is not divorced, evidently the husband's intention is not toward her advantage; so too regarding workers, we should not say that [the employer's] intention is toward the advantage of the employer. However, one should not explain that the husband's advantage is that she is not divorced quickly—for that is preferable to him than [her] being divorced immediately, since now it will still be in his power whether to keep [her] or to divorce [her]—and [that] now he resolves [the dilemma] simply; for [the passage] immediately following will not be reconciled, where [the Gemara] says: "Granted, if the opposite were stated, etc., once the bill of divorce reaches his hand she is divorced, [proving] that he relies on her statement." According to this [explanation], that would be to her detriment, in that she is divorced quickly, and [the Gemara] resolves [the dilemma] that all the more so one should rely on the employer's advantage. And if so, this contradicts the simple resolution above, where it was obvious to him that [the employer's] intention is toward the advantage that the agent stated and not toward the detriment of the employer, whereas here the husband relies on her detriment.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 76a:3:1.hebrew: ואזיל איהו אמר להו בארבעה דעתייהו אעילויא - והא דאמרו ליה "כמו שאמר בעה"ב" — היינו "מהימנת לן דהכי אמר בעה"ב", אי נמי: משום דאי אמר בעל הבית טפי מארבעה, שיהא להם כמו שאמר בעל הבית. והיינו דמבעיא ליה בתר הכי אי אמרינן "מהימנת לן דהכי אמר בעה"ב" אי משום דדעתיה אעילויא:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 76a:3:1.english: "And he went [and] told them [they were hired] for four ... their minds are on an additional [sum]" - And [as for] that which they said to him, "As the employer said" — this means, "We trust you that the employer said thus," or alternatively: because if the employer said more than four [dinars], they should have [the wage] as the employer said. And this is what [the Gemara] asks afterwards: whether we say, "We trust you that the employer said thus," or whether [they said it] because his mind is on an additional [sum].
